At n=m+2 the two specified adjacent m-node stencils with one outside point each admit opposite indicator pairs from impulses at the first and last nodes. Explicit Lagrange evaluation of step data at h/2 and the compact geometric-weight ratio yield (-1)^d C(2d,d)/(4^d[1+(2d+1)^{2μ}]); verified independently for d=1..8 with exact rational arithmetic. The proof extends to all full-spark real polynomial spaces, not just the checked grids.
